raw.description:
über deine stelle

Als Web Developer bei UPSTART bewegst du dich in einem innovativen und zugleich herausforderndem Umfeld. Du analysierst und strukturierst stetig komplexe Prozesse, konzipierst Lösungen und setzt diese in anspruchsvolle Webanwendungen um.

deine aufgaben

  • Du designst und implementierst neue Ideen in unterschiedlichen Programmiersprachen.
  • Du bildest dich dazu regelmäßig weiter, was neue Programmiersprachen und Techniken angeht.
  • Du berätst und schulst die Benutzer und führst Systemtests und Systemdokumentationen durch.

dein mindset

  • Du verfügst über unternehmerisches Denken.
  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.
  • Du bist zuverlässig und verlässlich auch in Extremsituationen.
  • Du denkst immer mit und bringst eigene Ideen ein.
  • Du stehst immer dem Team loyal zur Seite.
  • Du liebst es, eigenständig zu arbeiten.
  • Du bildest dich gerne weiter.

dein profil

  • Du hast ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung.
  • Du bringst ein hohes Maß an Selbstständigkeit und Qualitätsbewusstsein mit.
  • Du hast Spaß an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen Team.
  • Du verfügst über Kreativität, logisch-struk­turiertes Denken und eine große Portion technische Neugier.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der Ent­wick­lung von Web-Anwendungen und Kenntnisse im Umgang mit JavaScript und Frameworks mit.
  • Du bringst Praxis- oder Berufserfahrung mit.
  • Du hast ein selbstsicheres und sympathisches Auftreten.
  • Du stehst für ein gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild.

deine chancen

  • Du erlebst den Spirit des „Fortschritts“, mit welchem wir unsere Kunden anstecken, in unserem breit aufgestellten Team.
  • Du triffst auf kreative Köpfe, leidenschaftliche Macher und analytische Genies.
  • Du lebst mit uns Diversität – denn nur so können wir alle voneinander profitieren.
  • Du erarbeitest mit uns gemeinsam innovative Ideen und setzt diese proaktiv um.
  • Du bringst dich eigenverantwortlich mit ein und arbeitest an zukunftsorientierten Themen.
  • Du profitierst von flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
  • Du erreichst unsere zentralen Standorte mit einer sehr guten Verkehrsanbindung.

deine benefits

  • Moderne Arbeitsausstattung: Du bekommst von uns alles, was Du für die Arbeit im Büro, von zu Hause oder unterwegs benötigst. Dabei arbeiten wir überwiegend mit Microsoft und Apple Produkten.
  • Wir sind Remote unterwegs: Bei uns läuft alles digital und über mehrere Standorte hinweg. Deshalb bieten wir Dir deutschlandweit eine hohe Flexibilität, was deinen Arbeitsort angeht, abhängig von Deinem Projekteinsatz.
  • Wir leben neue Mobilität: Wir stellen Dir ein kostenloses E-Bike vom Münchner Startup Sushi-Bike oder einen E-Scooter von Xiaomi zu deiner freien Verfügung.
  • Mitarbeiter-Kreditkarte von SpendIT: Mit deiner eigenen Mitarbeiter-Kreditkarte gibt es bis zu 1.000 € pro Jahr steuerfrei extra zu deinem Gehalt und zu deiner freien Verfügung.
  • Lifelong Work and Travel durch Global Offices: Arbeite 30 Tage pro Jahr an einem Ort deiner Wahl mit unserem Office-Partner Spaces und entdecke ständig neue Länder und Kulturen. (ab 24 Monaten Betriebszugehörigkeit)

raw.description:
deine aufgaben

Wir suchen einen Teamplayer! Wir suchen Dich als Cyber Defense Analyst (m/w/d) – mit Fokus auf Microsoft Security

Deine Aufgaben werden von Anfang an herausfordernd und spannend sein, denn Du unterstützt Dein Team effektiv dabei, Cyberangriffe auf Unternehmen zu erkennen, zu analysieren und abzuwehren. Bei uns findest Du flache Hierarchien und eine offene, kooperative Arbeitsatmosphäre vor.

Kurze Entscheidungsprozesse, viel Verantwortung sowie exzellente Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind gute Argumente, sich für uns zu entscheiden.

Was wir von Dir erwarten und was Du mitbringen solltest, entnimmst Du bitte der Stellenbeschreibung und dem Anforderungsprofil.

Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung mit vielen aussagekräftigen Fakten über Dich!

Deine Aufgaben

Als Cyber Defense Analyst begleitest Du in zentraler Position unsere Kunden bei Analyse und Abwehr von Cyber-Angriffen in unserem Cyber Detection und Response Center (CDRC). Zusätzlich unterstützt Du beim Betrieb der SIEM- und XDR-Systeme unserer CDRC-Kunden – mit starkem Fokus auf Microsoft Security-Technologien.

Konkret erwartet Dich folgendes:

  • Tiefe Einarbeitung in die Technologien und Prozesse im CDRC

  • Spezialisierung auf Microsoft Defender XDR und Microsoft Sentinel

  • Wechselnde Analysetätigkeiten in verschiedenen Detektions- und Abwehrsystemen halten deinen Arbeitsalltag interessant

  • Design, Entwicklung und Tuning von Use Cases für Microsoft Sentinel

  • Threat Hunting in Microsoft Defender und Sentinel

  • Einleiten von Response-Maßnahmen zur Abwehr von Cyberangriffen

  • Erstellung und Optimierung von Playbooks mit Azure Logic Apps in Microsoft Sentinel

  • Erstellung und Wartung von Workbooks in Microsoft Sentinel für Reporting und Visualization

  • Enger Kundenkontakt für regelmäßigen Austausch mit den Security-Abteilungen unserer Kunden

  • Durchführung von internen Projekten sowie Spezialisierung in eingesetzten Technologien

  • Level 1 & 2 Analysen zur Unterstützung unseres Forensikteams beim Compromise Assessment

  • Entwicklung, Implementierung und Optimierung von Detektionsmechanismen in Microsoft-Ökosystem

  • Automatisierung von Security-Prozessen mit Microsoft Logic Apps und SOAR-Funktionen

  • Gute Work-Life-Balance im 24/7-Schichtmodell mit Incentives, die ein hervorragender Ausgleich zur Schichtarbeit darstellen

  • Mentoring von Kollegen mit weniger Berufserfahrung

dein profil

Pflichtanforderungen:

  • Mindestens 2–3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Aufbau und/oder dem Betrieb von Security Operations Centern (SOC) bzw. in angrenzenden Themenbereichen mit nachweisbarer Microsoft-Security-Expertise
  • Tiefe Kenntnisse in Microsoft Defender XDR: Detection, Investigation, Response im gesamten Defender-Ökosystem
  • Sehr gute Erfahrungen mit Microsoft Sentinel (SIEM/SOAR): Betrieb, Konfiguration, Monitoring
  • Use Case Design und Use Case Tuning: Du kannst Detection Rules erstellen, optimieren und an Kundenumgebungen anpassen
  • Threat Hunting-Erfahrung – proaktive Suche nach Bedrohungen in Logs und Daten
  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Playbooks und Workbooks in Microsoft Sentinel
  • Kenntnisse in Automatisierung mit Azure Logic Apps (SOAR-Funktionalität in Sentinel)
  • Eine solide Grundlage in allen Makrobereichen der IT (Networking, Betriebssysteme & grundlegendes Scripting)
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Eine analytische, strukturierte und eigenständige Denk- und Arbeitsweise
  • Eine hohe Kunden- und Serviceorientierung und Übernahme von Verantwortung im Team
  • Unternehmerisches Denken & Handeln
Microsoft-Zertifizierungen sind ein großes Plus:
  • SC-200 (Microsoft Security Operations Analyst) – erwünscht
  • SC-100 (Microsoft Cybersecurity Architect) – von Vorteil
  • SC-300 (Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator) – erwünscht
Wünschenswert:
  • Optional Reisebereitschaft (wir arbeiten aktuell vorwiegend remote)
  • Erfahrung mit SOAR-Prozessen und Automatisierung von Incident-Response-Workflows
  • Affinität zu datengesteuerter Sicherheitsanalyse und Threat Intelligence

was wir dir bieten

  • 30 Tage Erholungsurlaub pro Jahr
  • Digitale Arbeitsausstattung inkl. Laptop und Smartphone
  • Persönlicher Mentor während der Einarbeitung
  • Teilnahme an Firmen-Events
  • Regelmäßige Weiterbildungen
  • Standortunabhängiges Arbeiten*
  • Partiell flexible Arbeitszeiten*
  • Individuelle Firmenwagenregelung
  • Job-Rad
  • Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

über uns

SECUINFRA ist ein hochspezialisiertes und inhabergeführtes Unternehmen im Bereich Cyber Defense. Wir machen nicht alles, was irgendwie mit IT-Security zu tun hat, sondern wir erkennen, analysieren & reagieren auf Cyberangriffe. Darin sind wir exzellent. Wir bieten unseren Kunden kompetente, technische Beratung und erbringen Detection & Response Services im nationalen und internationalen Rahmen.

In den vergangenen Jahren haben viele kompetente und engagierte Mitarbeiter dazu beigetragen, dass SECUINFRA stark wachsen und zu einem der erfolgreichsten Unternehmen im Bereich Cyber Defense in Deutschland werden konnte.
Gewachsen sind wir mit dem Fokusthema Security Information & Event Management (SIEM), mittlerweile decken wir die gesamte, technische Palette im SOC-Umfeld ab und beschäftigen ausgewiesene Experten auch in den Bereichen Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR), Network Detection & Response (NDR), Security Orchestration Automation & Response (SOAR), Threat Intelligence, DFIR & Co.

raw.title: Sales Director - Remote (U.S.)
raw.excerpt: position detailsThe Role As Sales Director, you will play a central role in expanding Firely’s commercial footprint across the Americas.
raw.description:
position details

The Role

As Sales Director, you will play a central role in expanding Firely’s commercial footprint across the Americas. Partnering closely with the SVP of Growth, you will drive enterprise revenue growth, develop strategic market positioning, and build lasting relationships across the healthcare interoperability ecosystem.

This is a market-building leadership role, not a predefined territory sales position. You will combine strategic vision with hands-on execution while owning enterprise opportunities end-to-end.

Your focus will be on organizations implementing FHIR for interoperability, regulatory compliance, and advanced use of structured healthcare data. Key segments include payers, care providers, health technology vendors, value-based care organizations, data analytics companies, and government healthcare entities.

You will represent Firely by guiding organizations in adopting FHIR-based architectures, API enablement strategies, digital quality measures, and scalable interoperability frameworks.


Key Responsibilities

  • Drive enterprise revenue growth across the Americas, owning complex sales engagements from market development through multi-year contract execution and account expansion
  • Identify, develop, and close strategic opportunities within FHIR-driven markets, positioning Firely as a trusted interoperability partner
  • Engage senior technical stakeholders (CIOs, CTOs, product leaders, interoperability executives) in strategic conversations around healthcare data architecture, standards adoption, API strategy, compliance requirements, and digital quality measurement
  • Structure and negotiate enterprise agreements, including pricing strategy, commercial governance, and long-term partnership models
  • Build and expand strategic partnerships that strengthen Firely’s presence within the US digital health and interoperability ecosystem
  • Represent Firely as a visible market leader through industry events, thought leadership, ecosystem engagement, and active participation in the FHIR community
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, consulting, and marketing teams to align customer needs with solution capabilities and long-term product strategy
  • Contribute to defining Firely’s enterprise sales strategy, operating model, and go-to-market approach as we scale in the Americas

What We Are Looking For

  • 7–10 years of progressive enterprise business development or commercial leadership experience within a technical B2B environment
  • Familiary with the US healthcare ecosystem, including procurement dynamics, regulatory drivers, and complex stakeholder environments (experience with interoperability and FHIR strongly preferred)
  • Proven track record of originating and closing complex enterprise deals in the $100K–$1M range
  • Demonstrated success navigating long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving both executive and technical decision-makers
  • Strong commercial hunter mindset with the ability to independently build pipeline in an evolving market
  • Equally capable of driving long-term account growth, commercial governance, and strategic relationship expansion
  • Experience owning the full commercial lifecycle, from opportunity qualification and solution positioning to pricing strategy, contract negotiation, and post-sale commercial stewardship
  • Ability to engage credibly at C-level and senior technical levels
  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy and accountability in a scale-up environment
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across international, cross-functional teams
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% as needed
  • Resident of the United States
  • Spanish language skills are a plus

Who You Are

  • A commercial leader who thrives in building markets and shaping growth strategy
  • Entrepreneurial and proactive — you create momentum rather than wait for it
  • Commercially disciplined with strong operational follow-through
  • Energized by influencing enterprise transformation in healthcare data and interoperability
  • Motivated by ownership, visibility, and the opportunity to shape Firely’s long-term success in the Americas

Benefits We Offer

  • Fully remote working environment
  • Annual base of range ($120K - $130K) + performance-based commission structure
  • 401(k), health and medical benefits, life and disability insurance
  • 22 vacation days
  • Annual learning & development budget
  • Home office budget

Our Culture

This is a rare opportunity to help shape Firely’s commercial presence in the Americas at a pivotal stage of growth. You will have meaningful influence over how markets are developed, how partnerships are structured, and how we scale.

Firely is a mission-driven, collaborative organization with short communication lines and accessible leadership. You will operate in the U.S. market while representing a Dutch company — combining the ambition and pace of American healthcare technology with the directness, quality focus, and pragmatic culture of Europe.

Although our U.S. team operates remotely, connection matters. Our U.S. team gathers annually for in-person collaboration and strategy, and you will also travel each year to our headquarters in Amsterdam for company-wide connection, alignment, and team building.

You will join an international team that values ownership, clarity, integrity, and mutual support — working together to advance the future of healthcare interoperability.

raw.description:
dein gestaltungsfeld

Wir suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Vollzeit und unbefristet eine:n Senior Marketing Analytics Manager (all genders). Wir leben Remote-First (innerhalb Deutschlands), aber Du kannst selbst wählen, ob Du durch Deine Nähe zu einem unserer Standorte (München, Nürnberg, Köln, Hamburg, Berlin) auch hybrid oder ganz vor Ort arbeiten möchtest.


Marketingdaten gibt es viele. Klare Antworten darauf, welche Maßnahmen wirklich wirken, warum Kunden bleiben oder gehen und wo wir Budget besser einsetzen sollten, bisher zu wenige. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Als Senior Marketing Analytics Manager baust du bei Contabo die Grundlage für fundierte Marketing- und Wachstumsentscheidungen. Dein Job ist es nicht, Reports zu „befüllen“, sondern Zusammenhänge sichtbar zu machen, Hypothesen zu prüfen und daraus konkrete Empfehlungen abzuleiten. Du bringst Ordnung in eine komplexe Datenlandschaft, verbindest Kampagnen-, Kunden- und Produktdaten und sorgst dafür, dass Entscheidungen weniger aus dem Bauch und mehr auf belastbaren Fakten basieren.

Zu Beginn analysierst und bereinigst du unser bestehendes Tracking- und Attributionssetup: Pixel, Consent, Datenabweichungen zwischen Ads-Plattformen, CRM und Backend. Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über unsere Kundenstruktur – Länder, Produkte, Nutzungsverhalten – und etablierst erste Analysen für konkrete Fragestellungen. Dabei identifizierst du bewusst auch Quick Wins, wo Optimierungen sofort Wirkung zeigen.

Darauf aufbauend entwickelst du unsere Marketing-Analytics systematisch weiter. Du analysierst Customer Journeys und Funnels, führst Segmentierungs- und Kohortenanalysen durch, untersuchst Churn-Treiber und modellierst LTVs entlang von Kanälen und Kundengruppen. Deine Analysen enden nicht im Dashboard: Du leitest daraus klare Handlungsempfehlungen ab und bist Sparringspartner für Marketing, Produktmanagement und andere Stakeholder – auch dann, wenn deine Erkenntnisse bestehende Annahmen infrage stellen.

Langfristig etablierst du Customer Intelligence als festen Bestandteil unserer Entscheidungsprozesse.
Automatisierte Analysen, Alerts und erste Vorhersage-Ansätze (z. B. Churn- oder LTV-Prognosen) sorgen dafür, dass wir früher reagieren, gezielter investieren und nachhaltiger wachsen. Du wirst damit zu einer zentralen fachlichen Referenz für datenbasierte Marketing- und Produktentscheidungen – ohne Führungsverantwortung, aber mit klarer Ownership.

was uns überzeugt

Deine Persönlichkeit, gepaart mit:

  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit kanalübergreifenden Marketingdaten (Paid Ads, Affiliate, CRM) in subscription-based Geschäftsmodellen
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Marketing-Attribution, Performance-Kennzahlen (ROI, CAC/LTV, Marketing-Mix) und deren Grenzen
  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit Tracking-Setups (GA4, Google Tag Manager, Server-Side Tracking, Consent Mode)
  • Sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse zur eigenständigen Analyse und Auswertung von Daten
  • Erfahrung mit Funnel-, Customer-Journey- und Kohortenanalysen
  • Sicherer Umgang mit BI-Tools und Dashboards (z. B. Looker Studio, Tableau oder Power BI)
  • Erfahrung im Subscription-Business (nahezu Must-have)
  • Branchenkenntnisse in Hosting, Telekommunikation oder vergleichbaren Tech-/Plattformmodellen (nice to have)

darauf kannst du zählen

Bei Contabo sind wir stetig in Bewegung. Unser Wachstum eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten, Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Hier kommen Menschen zusammen, die Dinge voranbringen.

Was uns dabei ausmacht, sind Vertrauen, direkte Kommunikation und eine offene Feedbackkultur. Wir glauben daran, dass die besten Lösungen gemeinsam entstehen und jede:r die Möglichkeit hat, sich einzubringen, zu lernen und einen eigenen Footprint zu hinterlassen.

Zusätzlich bieten wir Dir:
  • Arbeite, wie es zu Dir passt – Remote oder hybrid mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance sowie mit technischer Ausstattung wie im Büro
  • Erlebe echte Freiheit – Workation im EU-Ausland und in unserem Summer Office auf Mallorca
  • Bleib aktiv und gesund – Zugang zum EGYM Wellpass mit tausenden Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten
  • Genieße exklusive Vorteile – Attraktive Konditionen durch unser Corporate-Benefits-Programm bei vielen Produkten und Dienstleistungen
  • Tanke neue Energie – 30 Tage Urlaub sowie zusätzliche freie Tage an Weihnachten und Silvester
  • Engagiere Dich – Ein zusätzlicher freier Tag für soziales Engagement im Rahmen unseres Volunteer Day
  • Gestalte mit und mache einen Unterschied – Große Gestaltungsfreiräume für Deine kreativen Ideen und echten Impact
  • Entwickle Dich weiter – Individuelle berufliche und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem innovativen und technologischen Umfeld
  • Arbeite, wo Du Dich wohlfühlst – Modern eingerichtete und verkehrsgünstig gelegene Büros an unseren europäischen Standorten
  • Werde Teil eines vielfältigen Teams – Arbeite in einem internationalen Umfeld, das von Diversität lebt
  • Erlebe echte Teammomente – Unvergessliche Events und gemeinsame Erlebnisse

job description

Join our outstanding journey!


At RAW iGaming, we set out with one clear ambition: to challenge conventions and create slot games that are innovative, entertaining, and easy to understand. Backed by experienced industry experts and strong investment, we’re a fast-growing studio where creativity, product thinking, and technical excellence thrive.

Casino games have a tendency to look boringly similar. We believe in making casino games that stand out. For that, we start with people who stand out.

We are looking for a Senior Backend Developer who wants to be part of building and scaling the technology behind our Live Casino platform, ensuring performance, reliability, and innovation at every step.

This role can be performed remotely or from our Malta office (hybrid model).

responsibilities

Your day-to-day will include:

  • Designing and implementing scalable, robust, and reliable backend systems to support our live casino platform
  • Ensuring high performance, security, and availability across all backend services
  • Collaborating closely with Product Owners, Developers, and QA Engineers to deliver new features and improvements
  • Building and maintaining well-documented and well-tested systems
  • Implementing monitoring and alerting solutions to proactively detect and resolve issues
  • Mentoring and supporting junior developers, helping them grow in both technical and domain knowledge
  • Continuously improving backend architecture by applying modern technologies and best practices
  • Contributing to a strong engineering culture focused on quality, collaboration, and delivery

qualifications

You're our ideal Senior Backend Developer if you:

  • Have at least 5 years of experience in backend development, working with scalable and high-performance systems
  • Are proficient in at least one backend programming language such as Java, Python, or Go
  • Have experience working with databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, and caching systems like Redis or Memcached
  • Have hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS or GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Possess a strong understanding of software engineering principles, including design patterns, algorithms, and data structures
  • Have experience or exposure to live casino environments, streaming systems, or similar real-time applications (highly valued)
  • Are fluent in English and comfortable working in cross-functional and international teams
  • Have the right to work within the EU

other information

What you can expect:

raw.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacart is seeking a Manager, Legal Technology & Operations to own the strategy and execution of innovative technology and operational initiatives that support both our legal department and broader business functions.

This role is a unique blend of strategic planning, technology leadership, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll work across procurement, accounting, HR, sales, deal desk, IT, engineering, and enterprise systems — driving automation, cost savings, and scalable processes that keep pace with Instacart's growth. If you thrive at the intersection of law, operations, and technology — and love building things that last — this role is for you.

About the Job

  • Lead strategic planning and execution of legal and business operations initiatives, with a focus on automating legal processes at scale — including Go-To-Market strategies, CPQ implementations and enhancements, and Ironclad support for new ad formats and retailer engagements.
  • Own the design and deployment of efficient, customer-centric operational methods within our Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) systems, ensuring cohesive cross-functional collaboration across teams including procurement, accounting, HR, sales, deal desk, IT, engineering, and enterprise systems.
  • Drive technology innovation by identifying and evaluating emerging tools and trends, leading the successful implementation and ongoing optimization of legal technology systems, and resolving technical issues that impact operations.
  • Implement procurement practices that generate cost savings in the contracting and review process — including Oracle, Zip, Salesforce and Workday integrations with CLM, and P2P merging with contract review workflows.
  • Manage the eBilling system and adhere to Billing Guidelines; participate in RFPs and law firm evaluations to drive accountability and increase cost-savings across the legal department.
  • Champion a transparent organizational culture by facilitating effective internal communication and advocating for the adoption of innovative processes across the business.

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in legal operations, strategy & operations, or a related field, with demonstrated experience managing technology systems and cross-functional programs.
  • Proven track record leading at least two end-to-end technology implementations with deep systems integrations (e.g., Ironclad, Zip, Salesforce, CPQ, Oracle, Workday, etc.)
  • Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to drive multiple complex initiatives simultaneously in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with direct experience collaborating across legal, finance, IT, and business teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a high-growth tech company or similarly dynamic organization where you've had to build and scale operations from the ground up.
  • Prior management experience, including team leadership or direct people management.
  • Familiarity with Go-To-Market operations, deal desk workflows, or sales process infrastructure.
  • Experience conducting vendor RFPs, law firm evaluations, or managing external legal spend.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify automation opportunities and lead change management efforts that drive organizational adoption of new processes.
  • Passion for leveraging emerging technology — including AI-powered tools — to enhance legal and business operations.

Instacart provides highly market-competitive compensation and benefits in each location where our employees work. This role is remote and the base pay range for a successful candidate is dependent on their permanent work location. Please review our Flex First remote work policy here.

Offers may vary based on many factors, such as candidate experience and skills required for the role. Additionally, this role is eligible for a new hire equity grant as well as annual refresh grants. Please read more about our benefits offerings here.

About Multi Media, LLC

Multi Media, LLC is the company behind Chaturbate, one of the most heavily trafficked live streaming platforms in the world. We support a global network of independent content creators and millions of real-time viewers, delivering interactive video at scale. Our infrastructure handles complex broadcasting, low-latency streaming, and high-engagement user experiences. All live, all the time.

We’re building a platform where creators can express themselves freely and grow their communities, where viewers discover and interact with creators they’re drawn to, and where the team behind it is challenged, trusted, and responsible for shaping the experience of millions of users around the world. We value people who take initiative, stay curious, and care deeply about the quality and impact of what they build.

The Role

We’re looking for a Tech Lead Manager to lead the team, which builds the systems that power personalized experiences, experimentation, audience targeting, and content delivery across our products. This team plays a critical role in helping the company deliver the right experience to the right user at the right time, and in building the platform foundation needed to scale that over time.

In this role, you’ll partner closely with Product, Design, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business strategy into engineering roadmaps and scalable systems. You’ll help clarify complex problem spaces, make thoughtful technical decisions across multiple services, and ensure the team builds the right foundation to support increasingly sophisticated experimentation and user personalization.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys balancing hands-on technical leadership with people management, stakeholder alignment, and long-term platform strategy.

You Will

  • Lead and develop a small team of engineers responsible for experience optimization systems across personalization, experimentation, audience generation, and content delivery.
  • Help build and scale the platform that powers personalized, in-session experiences for users across the site.
  • Create clarity in ambiguous problem spaces by connecting technical constraints, business priorities, and user experience goals.
  • Coach and mentor engineers on technical decision-making, execution, and career growth.

Requirements

You Have

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
  • Experience leading engineering teams as a people manager, technical lead, or Tech Lead Manager.
  • Strong software engineering background with experience working across full-stack systems, with a backend-heavy focus.
  • Strong backend experience in languages such as Go or Python.
  • Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with Product, Design, and other cross-functional partners to drive technical direction, roadmap planning, and execution across complex, user-facing platform systems.
  • Ability to define technical direction in ambiguous spaces and break broad goals into actionable plans for a team.
  • A track record of mentoring engineers and helping teams raise the bar technically and operationally.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience building systems related to experimentation, personalization, segmentation, audience targeting, or decisioning is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript and experience with modern frameworks such as Django or Flask.

Benefits

What You’ll Get

  • Fair and competitive base salary
  • Fully Remote Optional
  • Health, Vision, Dental, and Life Insurance for you and any dependents, with policy premiums covered by the Company
  • Long & Short term disability insurance
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Annual Year-End Company Closure
  • Optional 401k with 5% matching
  • 12 Paid Holidays
  • Paid Lunches in-office, or if Remote, a $125/week stipend via Sharebite
  • Employee Assistance and Employee Recognition Programs
  • And much more!

The Base Salary range for this position is $180,000 - $220,000 USD. This range reflects base salary only and does not include additional compensation or benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum range for a new hire across the US for the posted position. A candidate’s specific pay will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the candidate’s job-related skills, relevant education, training, experience, certifications, and abilities of the candidate, as well as other factors unique to each candidate.

About Intermedia
Are you looking for a company where YOUR VOICE is heard? Where you can MAKE A DIFFERENCE? Do you THRIVE in a FAST-PACED work environment? Do you wake every morning EXCITED to work with GREAT PEOPLE and create SUCCESSTOGETHER? Then Intermedia is the place for you.
Intermedia has established itself as a leading provider of cloud communications and collaboration tech that allows companies to connect better. We have a strong track record of growth, profitability, and creating an environment where everyone matters. Everyone. While we are fast-paced and admittedly a bit intense, we promise that you won’t be bored. What’s more, we always look to promote from within and have many employees who have been with us 10, 15, and 20+ years!
Culture at Intermedia is built on teamwork and transparency. We hold each other accountable and always have each other’s back!
Are you ready to make your mark?

About the role: We are looking for a Senior Resource Plane Platform Engineer to join Intermedia and help build, operate, and evolve the Resource Plane of our Internal Developer Platform (IDP). This is a senior individual contributor role with staff-level expectations, operating in a small, high-impact team responsible for shared, non-database runtime services. The Resource Plane Team owns critical infrastructure services such as event streaming, messaging, caching, object storage, and logging backends. The scope of this platform is expected to evolve over time, requiring engineers who are comfortable operating under ambiguity and taking ownership of complex, stateful systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the design, implementation, and operation of shared Resource Plane services used across the organization
  • Operate and evolve Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and Elasticsearch platforms in production
  • Apply SRE principles to ensure availability, scalability, reliability, and safe upgrades of stateful systems • Build and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code and GitOps-based automation for provisioning and lifecycle management
  • Define and enforce supported usage patterns, guardrails, and golden paths for platform consumers
  • Integrate Resource Plane services into the Internal Developer Platform for self-service consumption • Participate in on-call rotation (initially may include 24x7 weekly rotation; target state is business-hours primary)
  • Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and reliability improvements for owned services
  • Collaborate closely with Kubernetes Platform Team, IDP and other teams as required
  • Act as a senior technical voice in architecture discussions and platform roadmap planning

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Information Technology
  • Senior-level experience operating production-grade, stateful distributed systems
  • Strong hands-on experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and Elasticsearch
  • Proven experience running infrastructure primarily in on-prem environments
  • Strong understanding of Linux systems, networking, and storage fundamentals
  • Deep experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform preferred)
  • Experience with GitOps workflows and declarative infrastructure management
  • Solid grasp of reliability engineering concepts (SLOs, error budgets, alerting, capacity planning)
  • Experience working with Kubernetes-adjacent platforms and services
  • Ability to operate independently and take ownership in a small team environment
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience designing shared platform services consumed by multiple product teams
  • Familiarity with IDP concepts and developer self-service platforms
  • Experience migrating on-prem workloads toward cloud-native or hybrid models
  • Exposure to security, compliance, and governance requirements for shared infrastructure
  • Prior experience in staff- or principal-level technical leadership roles

das sind wir:

Lust auf eine Rolle, in der aktiv am Aufbau eines Partnernetzwerks im Healthcare-Umfeld mitgearbeitet wird?
Willkommen im Dental-Tech. Wir sind Patient21 und wir bringen Zahnarztpraxen digital ins 21. Jahrhundert. Neben unserer Software bauen wir ein starkes Ökosystem aus Partnern auf – von Plattformen über Dienstleister bis hin zu strategischen Kooperationen.
Für den weiteren Ausbau suchen wir Unterstützung im Bereich Business Development und Partnermanagement.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist?

Du baust etwas auf, das wirklich zählt – ein Partnernetzwerk, das Zahnarztpraxen in ganz Deutschland vernetzt und mit dem Unternehmen wächst.

Dabei entsteht ein breites Verständnis für Business Development, strategische Zusammenarbeit und operative Umsetzung – in einer Branche, die gerade erst beginnt, sich zu verändern.

wir bieten dir:

  • Eine steile Lernkurve durch echte Projekte und echte Verantwortung – kein Praktikumsprojekt, das in der Schublade landet

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die sich mit Studium oder anderen Verpflichtungen kombinieren lassen
  • Die Chance, einen Kanal aufzubauen, der mit dem Unternehmen skaliert
  • Ein junges, unkompliziertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echter Hands-on-Kultur
  • Kostenlose Snackbar und Getränke im Büro
  • Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge und weitere Mitarbeiter-Benefits

angebot:

Der Job in a Nutshell

Du baust unser Netzwerk aus Vertriebspartnern und Resellern auf, entwickelst es weiter und erschließt damit zusätzliche Vertriebspotenziale.

Bei Patient21 digitalisieren wir das Gesundheitswesen – mit einem Plattformansatz aus ganzheitlicher Software und ineinandergreifenden Services, die wir Zahnarztpraxen in ganz Deutschland anbieten.

Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der unser Partnerökosystem von Grund auf mitgestaltet.

Ideal auch für Werkstudent:innen mit Interesse an Business Development & Partnerschaften.

aufgaben:

  • Identifikation und Recherche relevanter Partner im Dental- und Healthcare-Umfeld

  • Mitarbeit bei der Umsetzung von Kooperationsprojekten
  • Pflege und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Partnerbeziehungen
  • Dokumentation und Pflege aller Aktivitäten im CRM

was erwartet dich:

  • Du recherchierst, wer im Dental- und Healthcare-Umfeld als Partner Sinn ergibt – und gehst dann aktiv auf sie zu
  • Du hilfst dabei, Partnerstrategien zu strukturieren, Kooperationen umzusetzen und bestehende Beziehungen weiterzuentwickeln
  • Kein klassischer Sales-Job, sondern ein Mix aus Business Development und Projektarbeit – mit direktem Einfluss auf den Aufbau eines neuen Kanals
  • Du arbeitest direkt mit Sales, Marketing und Management zusammen – und hältst deine Aktivitäten sauber im CRM fest

was bringst du mit:

  • Strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und sicheres Auftreten

Innovation is and will always be the core of SAP Fioneer, and it is the promise of why we were spun out of SAP: agility, innovation, and delivery.

SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms. We are helping companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability, and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end.

A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future!

Description

Business-to-business embedded finance is shaping the next chapter of financial services. At SAP Fioneer, you will work on scalable, cloud-based solutions that power real-world banking and finance processes. This is your opportunity to combine deep SAP expertise with an entrepreneurial mindset in a global, fast-growing environment.

About the role

As an SAP BTP Integration Developer, you design, build, and deliver integration-driven product features on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP). You work closely with customers, product owners, and technical stakeholders to ensure robust, secure, and scalable integrations aligned with SAP Fioneer standards.

Key responsibilities

  • Work directly with customers and solution or product owners to deliver product features based on user stories and tasks in Jira
  • Own the end-to-end development of software features, including coding, testing, bug fixing, and technical documentation
  • Support sales opportunities by providing reliable effort estimations for user stories
  • Create transparency through regular reporting on progress, utilization, risks, and blockers
  • Collaborate with the CTO office on SAP BTP and S/4HANA infrastructure setup, ensuring compliance with internal standards and guidelines

Requirements

  • 5+ years of development experience with at least 3 years with SAP technologies
  • Bachelor’s degree or above in IT/ Computer Science/ Physics/Mathematics/Engineering or related discipline
  • Deep knowledge in SAP Business Technology Platform architecture, solution design, best practice, and handling critical issue resolution
  • Proven experience with SAP ERP integration using ALE/SAP IDocs/RFC/Web Services/REST/oData, Process Integration/Orchestration, SAP Integration Suite.
  • Experience of developing new APIs using SAP Integration Suite preferred
  • Knowledgeable in SAP UI5, SAP Fiori, SAP Business Application studio and SAP’s Cloud Application Programming Model
  • Expertise in Agile tools such as: Confluence, Jira and Github.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English

Benefits

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector. This is an environment where you can have it all - the agility, enthusiasm and dynamism of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence and extensive customer network of a more established organisation.

At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages creativity and encourages you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you will have the chance to chart your own career path and take advantage of competitive compensation packages and progression opportunities based on merit.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes occupational pension provisions, support for health and wellbeing, various mobility options like bike leasing and transportation allowances, as well as additional perks such as celebration rewards, jubilee recognition, and relocation reimbursement.

OUR HIRING PROCESS:

  • We will review your application against our job requirements. We do not employ machine learning technologies during this phase as we believe every human deserves attention from another human. We do not think machines can evaluate your application quite like our seasoned recruiting professionals—every person is unique. We promise to give your candidacy a fair and detailed assessment.
  • We may then invite you to submit a video interview for the review of the hiring manager. This video interview is often followed by a test or short project that allows us to determine whether you will be a good fit for the team.
  • At this point, we will invite you to interview with our hiring manager and/or the interview team. Please note: We do not conduct interviews via text message, Telegram, etc. and we never hire anyone into our organization without having met you face-to-face (or via Zoom). You will be invited to come to a live meeting or Zoom, where you will meet our INFUSE team.
  • From there on, it’s decision time! If you are still excited to join INFUSE and we like you as much, we will have a conversation about your offer. We do not make offers without giving you the opportunity to speak with us live.

    INFUSE is committed to complying with applicable data privacy and security laws and regulations. For more information, please see our Privacy Policy

We're looking for a Senior Project Manager with a Business Analysis or Product Management background to lead strategic initiatives end-to-end - from process analysis and solution design through to implementation and automation. You combine strong project management skills with analytical thinking to drive meaningful improvements at both the team and company levels.

What You'll Do

  • Lead multiple projects simultaneously across departments, delivering on time, within scope, and on budget
  • Own end-to-end project delivery: planning, solution design, budgeting, resource allocation, and risk management
  • Analyze workflows and business processes to identify inefficiencies and translate them into actionable requirements
  • Drive process improvements through process modeling, data analysis, and gap analysis
  • Lead change management efforts, ensuring smooth transitions and stakeholder buy-in
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams on the integration of systems, processes, and technology solutions
  • Keep stakeholders aligned throughout - requirements gathering, progress updates, and expectation management

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of project management experience
  • Background in Business Analysis or Product Management
  • Proven track record of improving business processes and implementing changes into products or operations
  • Experience managing cross-functional teams across business and technical stakeholders
  • Upper-Intermediate or Advanced English
  • Nice to have: hands-on experience implementing AI into products or processes with measurable results
  • Nice to have: proficiency in no-code/low-code tools (n8n, Zapier, Make, Bubble, Bolt, etc.)

We strive to make our hiring process fair and comfortable for all candidates. Our process may include one-way video interviews, behavioral assessments, and timed cognitive tests. If you are an individual with a disability or are neurodiverse and need specific accommodations—such as extra time on a test, an alternative communication format, or flexible scheduling—please feel free to let us know. We’re happy to work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

raw.description:
about us:

Spectrum.Life is a whole-of-health digital partner that guides organisations and their people to thrive, delivering clinically backed digital health, mental health and wellbeing solutions.

Our HealthTech delivers digital transformation for Insurers, Educators and Employers through Co-creation or seamlessly integrated out-of-the-box solutions, that decrease digital fragmentation and engage, empower, and transform their people’s lives.

Established in 2018 by Stuart McGoldrick and Stephen Costello, Spectrum.Life provides services internationally to over 7.2m insurance members, 3,000 corporate clients, 60 universities and 650,000 university students. Spectrum.Life currently employs over 450 people.

Our vision is to change and save as many lives as possible.

role brief:

We are looking for a proactive, reliable, and fully qualified Psychotherapist/Counsellor to help us provide access to professional services while also overseeing other individuals engaging in the service. The role of the EAP Advice line Counsellor is suited to fully qualified Psychotherapists / Counsellors. This role will require evaluating the needs of our clients, conducting screening assessments, assessing for any immediate risk, performing crisis containment, and signposting to any helpful resources.

schedule:

After 3 weeks of fully paid training, delivered fully remote from Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm, the set schedule will be either 3 × 10-hour shifts or 4 × 10-hour shifts, with 1 weekend day worked (either Saturday or Sunday) as a fixed part of the schedule.

responsibilities:

  • Carrying out screening assessments over the phone with individuals wishing to engage with EAP services, focusing on strengths as well as difficulties.
  • To conduct risk assessments and implement risk management plans as appropriate, with the support of our Psychological Triage team and provide appropriate safety and action planning where necessary
  • Assess client’s needs and provide immediate telephone crisis counselling/interventions to employees and family members of customer organisations
  • Identify the presenting problem and determine appropriate service response level as per case response level standards
  • Meet key objectives around call volume and quality.
  • First point of contact to our clients via phone, sms, live chat and WhatsApp
  • To operate within all policies, procedures and guidelines of the EAP service.
  • To participate in team meetings and attend other meetings as deemed necessary.
  • Excellent customer service skills with strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to cope with a high volume of incoming calls and chats.
  • Works well under pressure
  • Enjoys working to targets around call volumes and call quality
  • To be flexible regarding working hours.
  • Reviewing and handling of cases/queries that need to be investigated/escalated either from individual service user perspective or client organisational level
  • Liaising with clinical governance around complex, high risk case
  • Working on specific tasks required relating to service development, expansion of service.
  • Work collaboratively with other clinical and non-clinical teams to ensure a seamless client experience for our clients

requirements:

  • Hold a recognised qualification in Counselling or Psychotherapy
  • Minimum of 200 post-qualified accrued counselling hours. We may report from the supervisor to verify.
  • Full registered membership and/ or accreditation with a professional association or organisation which is governed by a recognised code of ethics and disciplinary process (i.e. ACP/PSI/BACP/BPS/UKCP/BABCP/EAPA/COSCA/CORST/NCPS /APCP) is an essential requirement. Unfortunately, Individual and Student Membership cannot be accepted
  • Strong computer skills and mastering current software and applications (such as Microsoft Office) Ability to work at a fast paced environment and to meet key objectives around call volume and quality.
  • Ability to adapt to both the ever changing client and organizational needs
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and to multi-task, when needed
  • Strong empathy and listening skills
  • Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, evenings, holidays etc. as per business needs
  • Experience working with a variety of clients reflecting a wide range of clinical presentations.
  • Experience of screening clients & carrying out initial screening appointments.
  • Strong risk assessment skills with regards to Child Welfare/Safety concerns, Suicide/Self-Harm, Substance Abuse etc.
  • Good clinical judgement and understanding of your responsibilities regarding confidentiality
  • Strong work ethic and professionalism
  • Ability to work over the phone and through chat
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Confidential Working Environment: Clinicians must be able to work from a private, confidential space to ensure client conversations remain secure and aligned with professional counselling standards.

desirable:

  • Experience working with clients using short term models of therapeutic intervention, particularly CBT
  • Experience working within a busy EAP service
  • Experience working on phone lines

what are the benefits of working at spectrum.life?

  • Part-time or Full-Time permanent contract
  • Work from home from anywhere in the UK. The role cannot be performed from overseas.
  • Full training provided between Monday and Friday, 9 am to 5 pm, for 3 weeks
  • Career Progression for clinical and non-clinical colleagues ­
  • 1 hour of individual clinical supervision per month in-house
  • Extensive list of employee perks and benefits: https://app.box.com/s/6wwkvowbev6cn7tlvq9yz32amnpmnvcl

raw.description:
We are looking for a technically strong and detail-oriented architect to join our design team within the real estate development business, focusing on boutique hospitality assets.

In this role, you will be responsible for translating the design intent into fully coordinated, precise, and buildable documentation. You will work across all design stages with a focus on technical development - from RIBA Stage 3 through construction, ensuring that the project’s quality, constructability, and coordination are preserved throughout. You will collaborate with the broader design and engineering team and serve as a key point of contact for design problem-solving, system integration, and detailing.

This role is focused on the later design phases. Personal engagement in RIBA 3-5 will be around 75%, with early-stage design support and feasibility input up to 25%.

We expect you to be highly proficient in Revit (including parametric families, freeform modeling, and terrain modeling), with strong BIM coordination experience. You should also have a solid understanding of construction methodologies, materials, detailing, and multi-disciplinary integration. Experience with Navisworks is required; Rhino, AutoCAD, and Enscape are a plus.

To succeed in this role, you should be independent, analytical, proactive in solving technical and coordination challenges, and capable of consistently delivering high-quality, buildable design packages. Fluency in English is essential.

  • This is a full time day job with expected involvement up to 40 hours a week
  • This is a fully remote job
  • We work normal central European time zone (CET) working hours 9-17 or 10-18, we expect you to participate in daily team's meetings
  • Utopia does not provide visa sponsorship and/or relocation package for this position

Requirements

  • Work on a variety of high-end hospitality projects, with a focus on technical development, spatial coordination, and construction-level detailing
  • Translate concept and schematic designs into coordinated, buildable Revit models and documentation packages across RIBA Stages 3–5
  • Develop precise technical layouts, assemblies, and details in Revit, ensuring consistency with design intent, constructability, and regulatory requirements
  • Coordinate architectural models with structural, MEP, and interior design inputs using BIM workflows and Navisworks
  • Review, resolve, and prevent coordination issues across disciplines; propose feasible, well-integrated technical solutions
  • Build and manage project typologies, families, and detail libraries to support efficient design development and standardization
  • Support tender and construction documentation preparation, ensuring alignment with specifications, codes, and local regulations
  • Assist in the development of project-specific systems and façade/roof/technical typologies based on construction logic and material performance
  • Provide quality control on Revit models and documentation across the team; conduct technical reviews and flag risks early
  • Collaborate with the procurement team on technical inputs related to material quantities, specifications, and product compatibility
  • Stay up to date with building systems, construction methods, and BIM automation tools; research and implement best practices in technical design
  • Supervise and guide BIM modelers and junior technical staff; support in building department-wide technical workflows and standards

raw.excerpt: The role of the Campaign Marketing Manager is to maximise the impact of marketing and PR assets and enable sales funnel growth.
raw.description:
The role of the Campaign Marketing Manager is to maximise the impact of marketing and PR assets and enable sales funnel growth. Working in close partnership with both marketing and sales you will lead the strategic development and execution of all key account campaigns including social media channels, with a strategy that amplifies complementary campaigns and further leverages marketing and PR collateral to attract leads for sales, whilst also using PR tactics to amplify proprietary data and research findings. The Campaign Marketing Manager will also act as a brand ‘gatekeeper’, ensuring that brand guidelines are followed in all external-facing communication..

Key Responsibilities

What you’ll do to succeed:

Sales Enablement, Demand Generation and Collaboration:

  • Educate and inform the sales team through regular attendance at forecasting meetings, providing insights into campaign performance, lead generation, and customer engagement.
  • Foster a collaborative working relationship between marketing and sales teams, facilitating alignment on goals, strategies, and tactics.
  • Work closely with sales stakeholders to develop account-based marketing plans aimed at achieving their targets, and generate high quality leads.

Campaign Strategy Development and Execution:

  • Lead the strategic development and execution of key account campaigns in collaboration with sales stakeholders, ensuring alignment with sales targets and objectives.
  • Develop comprehensive account-based marketing plans to drive engagement and conversions within target accounts.
  • Develop and execute strategies to deliver key performance indicators (KPIs), optimising campaign performance across all channels.
  • Utilise analytical reporting to evaluate campaign effectiveness and inform ongoing and future activities.
  • Conduct monthly marketing reviews to track campaign productivity and iterate existing campaigns for continuous improvement.

CRM Marketing Automation and Content Creation:

  • Take a lead role in CRM marketing automation and daily execution, setting strategy and creating compelling content to nurture leads and drive conversions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless integration of CRM initiatives with overall marketing campaigns and sales efforts.
  • Oversee the development of compelling campaign creative assets, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines, messaging, and audience preferences.

Social Media Campaigns and Amplification:

  • Design, plan, and execute complementary social media campaigns to amplify marketing collateral and increase brand visibility.
  • Develop strategies to leverage social media channels effectively, engaging target audiences and driving traffic to key campaign assets.

Growth Initiatives and Resource Allocation:

  • Drive growth across all M3 market research companies by developing comprehensive marketing campaigns that support their objectives and integrate seamlessly with existing initiatives.
  • Control and measure resources available for specific initiatives, allocating and prioritising resources to maximise return on investment (ROI).
  • Experience of working in HubSpot / other CRM platforms with the ability to pivot to Hubspot
  • Previous marketing experience, preferably in a B2B environment
  • Social media planning experience, especially Linkedin
  • A creative thinker with the capacity to develop engaging campaigns
  • Excellent copywriting skills and content creation for web, social media, and email
  • Motivated by an exciting and collaborative team environment
  • Able to make decisions, take ownership and accept accountability
  • Self-motivated and driven with a passion for excellence
  • Self-directed worker with the professionalism and focus to work relatively autonomously, albeit with the support of marketing and sales colleagues
  • Excellent verbal and written communicator with an eye for detail

Employee Benefits:

  • 25 days annual leave
  • Participation in a company bonus scheme linked to personal and company performance
  • Group Life Cover 4x salary
  • Pension 4%/4% employee/employer contributions
  • Vitality after probation
  • Staff discount scheme
  • Discounted gym membership​

About M3: A Japanese global leader in the provision of ground-breaking and innovative technological and research solutions to the healthcare industry. The M3 Group operates in the US, Asia, and Europe with over 5.8 million physician members globally via its physician websites which include mdlinx.com, m3.com, research.m3.com, Doctors.net.uk, medigate.net, and medlive.cn. M3 Inc. is a publicly traded company on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (jp:2413, NIKKEI 225) with subsidiaries in major markets including the US, UK, Japan, South Korea, and China, and in 2020 was ranked in Forbes’ Global 2000 list. The M3 Group provides services to healthcare and the life science industry. In addition to market research, these services include medical education, ethical drug promotion, clinical development, job recruitment, and clinic appointment services. M3 has offices in Japan, UK, France, Germany, Brazil, Sweden, China, USA, and South Korea, as well as India.

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

raw.description:
Quorum is looking to hire an Assistant Controller to join our Finance department. The Assistant Controller’s responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to, overseeing core accounting operations, financial reporting, internal controls, tax compliance, FP&A, covenant analysis, and supporting the Senior Director, Finance, in all aspects of the finance function. The Assistant Controller will be guided by solid business instincts, strong ethics, and sound judgment developed through progressive accounting experience. This individual will quickly establish and maintain cooperative working relationships across departments and at all levels of the organization, bringing strong technical accounting expertise and a proactive approach to problem-solving. The Assistant Controller will confidently manage competing priorities, drive process improvements, and support the development of junior finance team members.

Here is what we will expect from you at work:

• Oversee and manage month end, quarter end, and year end close procedures, ensuring all accounting entries are posted accurately and working papers are prepared for all General Ledger accounts.

• Develop, prepare, and maintain continuity schedules and reconciliations for all balance sheet accounts.

• Lead preparation of monthly variance analysis and budget-to-actual reports, with commentary for senior leadership.

• Prepare and review monthly financial reporting packs, ensuring accuracy and timeliness for internal and external stakeholders.

• Prepare and review monthly and quarterly covenant reporting packs, ensuring compliance with all debt covenants and lender requirements.

• Oversee the preparation of quarterly and annual financial statements and reports in accordance with IFRS.

• Review, coach, and mentor junior and intermediate finance team members; provide technical guidance and support their professional development.

• Own compliance for Sales Taxes, Corporate Taxes, and Deferred Taxes, including all reporting, filing, and liaison with external tax advisors.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for the annual external audit and annual corporate tax filing; coordinate with auditors and advisors to ensure a smooth and efficient process.

• Partner with the Senior Director of Finance on strategic initiatives, ad-hoc analysis, and process improvement projects.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA designation required (or near completion).

• 4-6 years of progressive experience in accounting or finance, with at least 2 years in a senior or supervisory accounting role.

• Experience with IFRS is required; public company or SaaS industry experience is a strong asset.

• A Proven ability to manage and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced, multi-entity environment.

• Demonstrated experience consolidating and interpreting financial data from multiple systems and sources.

• Advanced computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite (Excel expertise required); experience with ERP systems is an asset.

• Strong communication skills, both verbal and written Additional Requirements

• Criminal background check required

Benefits

What We Offer 

  • A chance to be a part of a team of professionals committed to innovation, initiative, integrity & teamwork. 
  • A full-time schedule, consisting of 40 scheduled hours per week. 
  • Strong benefits offerings beginning after 3 months of employment. 
  • Company match RRSP Plan
  • Access to our employee assistance program.

Das Leben unserer Werte Respekt, Offenheit, Vertrauen und Fürsorge sorgt für eine ausgezeichnete Unternehmenskultur und ist die Basis unseres Erfolgs.

Nutze auch du deine Leidenschaft für Daten & Innovation und erschließe mit uns deren Potential. So schaffen wir gemeinsam einen Mehrwert für Kunden, Gesellschaft und Umwelt.

deine bunte aufgabenpalette

DevOps wird durchgehend gelebt: Du entwickelst in einem DevOps-Team eigenständig Cloud- und On-prem- Data Pipelines als Fundament von Datenplattformen.

Übersetzen und Umsetzen von Anforderungen: Basierend auf den fachlichen Anforderungen erstellst du technische Data Engineering Konzepte und setzt diese im Code mit um. Dein Wissen über Technologieformen mit passender Werkzeugunterstützung (Coding, ETL, Data Prep, Streaming), datenhaltender Systeme (Blob Stores-, SQL-, NoSQL-, Document-, Node-Datenbanken) und modernste Modellierungstechniken setzt du zielgerichtet dazu ein, Kunden bei Proof of Concepts zu unterstützen und Kundenanforderungen in Projekten zu realisieren.

über uns – talentspring academy group

Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mithalten können – aber die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht? Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland verfügen über keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss. Gleichzeitig transformieren KI, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle ganze Branchen – schneller, als das Bildungssystem reagieren kann. In nahezu allen zukunftsrelevanten Sektoren fehlen qualifizierte Fachkräfte. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren.

Genau hier setzen wir an: Mit digitalen, staatlich geförderten Weiterbildungen, die Menschen beruflich neu aufstellen, Chancengleichheit stärken, digitale Kompetenzen breit vermitteln – und so den Wirtschaftsstandort Deutschland langfristig zukunftsfähig machen.

Die Talentspring Academy Group ist ein dynamisch wachsender Verbund staatlich anerkannter digital-first Bildungseinrichtungen mit klarem Fokus auf digitale Berufsfelder. Wir qualifizieren Menschen ohne formalen Abschluss, Quereinsteiger:innen und Arbeitssuchende und Arbeitnehmende für gefragte Tätigkeiten in der digitalen Arbeitswelt – staatlich zertifiziert, praxisnah und anschlussfähig. Was uns besonders macht: Wir verbinden die Geschwindigkeit und Innovationskraft eines EdTechs mit der Reichweite und Glaubwürdigkeit etablierter Bildungsstrukturen. Durch strategische Partnerschaften im Bildungssektor verfügen wir über eine bundesweite Infrastruktur mit mehreren hundert Standorten, tiefem institutionellem Vertrauen und direktem Zugang zu unseren Zielgruppen – über digitale wie lokale Kanäle. Das schafft Marktzugang, Vertrauen und nachhaltige Skalierbarkeit in einem regulierten Umfeld.

Wir stehen vor dem nächsten Wachstumsschub – mit klarem Produkt-Markt-Fit, KI-first-DNA, gesellschaftlichem Hebel und einem einzigartigen Marktzugang, den kein anderer Anbieter in dieser Form replizieren kann.

Jetzt ist der perfekte Zeitpunkt, um einzusteigen – und mitzugestalten, wie Bildung in Deutschland neu gedacht wird. Bist Du dabei?

über die rolle

unser bekenntnis zur chancengleichheit

Wir bei Talentspring sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechtsidentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Talentspring steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Uns ist es besonders wichtig, das jede:r sich zu seinem/ihrem vollsten Potential entwickelt und in keinster Weise Benachteiligung erfährt. Wir sind stolz auf unser diverses Team und stellen sicher, dass wir in jeder Besetzung diese gelebte Diversität auch erfüllen.

This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the APAC region through research, networking, and industry events.

  • Skills:

Compensation Structure

Collaboration will be essential.   • Proven experience with React and TypeScript, building scalable and maintainable applications.
  • Experience acting as a technical reference or informal team lead in small teams.
  • Strong experience defining and evolving frontend architectures (modular systems, monorepos, shared libraries).
  • Designing and maintaining design systems aligned with product and UX needs.

  • Deep knowledge of the React ecosystem and modern frontend tooling.

  • Strong mentoring and leadership skills: enabling others through feedback, pairing, and guidance.

Du übernimmst die Steuerung und Koordination von Datacenter- und Infrastrukturprojekten – mit klarem Schwerpunkt auf Migrationen, Rollouts und operativen Infrastrukturveränderungen.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Infrastructure-, Network- und Operations-Teams sowie externen Dienstleistern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass technische Änderungen strukturiert, nachvollziehbar und stabil umgesetzt werden.

Du startest im Team mit enger fachlicher Begleitung und wächst schrittweise in die eigenständige Verantwortung für komplexere Infrastruktur- und Migrationsprojekte hinein.
Je nach Projektphase bist du dabei nicht nur koordinierend tätig, sondern auch nah an der operativen Umsetzung, um technische Abhängigkeiten und Auswirkungen realistisch einschätzen zu können.

Ziel ist, dass du mittelfristig eigenständig größere Infrastrukturprojekte steuerst und damit aktiv zur Stabilisierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datacenter-Umgebungen beiträgst.

was uns überzeugt

Deine Persönlichkeit, gepaart mit:

  • mehrjähriger Erfahrung im IT-Infrastruktur-, Hosting- oder Rechenzentrumsumfeld
  • solidem Verständnis von Server-, Netzwerk- oder Datacenter-Infrastrukturen
  • erster Erfahrung in der Koordination oder Steuerung technischer Projekte oder Betriebsabläufe
  • der Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und Auswirkungen von Changes einzuschätzen
  • einer strukturierten, verlässlichen und priorisierungsstarken Arbeitsweise
  • sehr guten Kommunikationsfähigkeit zwischen technischen Teams und Stakeholdern
  • sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
Nice-to-have:
  • Erfahrung mit Datacenter-Migrationen oder Infrastruktur-Rollouts
  • Betriebssystemkenntnisse (Linux und/oder Windows Server)
  • Arbeit in Hosting-, Cloud- oder MSP-Umgebungen
  • Erfahrung mit Jira, Confluence oder vergleichbaren Tools im technischen Kontext

darauf kannst du zählen

Bei Contabo sind wir stetig in Bewegung. Unser Wachstum eröffnet neue Möglichkeiten, Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und aktiv mitzugestalten. Hier kommen Menschen zusammen, die Dinge voranbringen.

raw.description:
deine mission

Als Cloud Network Engineer bei SysEleven bist du der treibende Faktor für die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Netzwerkkomponenten auf allen Ebenen unseres OpenStack basierten Syseleven-Stacks. Du baust eine effiziente und stabile Netzwerkinfrastruktur aus und implentierst neue features. Durch Deine Expertise im Bereich Cloud Network Engineering trägst Du in Deinem Fachgebiet zur Steigerung der technischen Anpassungsfähigkeit, Effizienz, Problemlösungskompetenz und technischen Exzellenz im Team und im gesamten Unternehmen bei.

deine aufgaben

  • Entwurf und Entwicklung von Netzwerkkomponenten, einschließlich Planung und Implementierung neuer Netzwerkfunktionen, Optimierung bestehender Komponenten und Gewährleistung einer stabilen und effizienten Netzwerkinfrastruktur
  • Fehlerbehebung bei Netzwerkproblemen, Analyse und Behebung von Problemen, um eine reibungslose Kommunikation und Konnektivität sicherzustellen
  • Entwicklung und Implementierung von Automatisierungslösungen für Netzwerkkonfigurationen und CI/CD-Pipelines mit Tools wie Ansible, GitLab und Terraform
  • Verbesserung des Monitorings, um eine effektive Netzwerküberwachung sicherzustellen
  • Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Teams und Abteilungen zur Optimierung der Netzwerkinfrastruktur und Gewährleistung einer reibungslosen Integration

das bringst du mit

  • Umfangreiche Kenntnisse des Linux Networking Stack
  • Erfahrung mit Software Defined Networking (SDN), insbesondere Open Virtual Network (OVN) und Open vSwitch (OVS).
  • Gute Kenntnisse von OpenStack, insbesondere Neutron
  • Vertrautheit mit Netzwerkprotokollen wie Anycast, BGP, eVPN, VXLAN und IPSec
  • Erfahrung in der Konfigurationsverwaltung mit Ansible.
  • Fließende Englischkenntnisse und Bereitschaft für Teilnahme Rufbereitschaft im Rahmen des 2nd Level

was dich bei uns erwartet

Wir sind die Wächter einer beeindruckenden Infrastruktur, eine OpenStack Cloud mit über 15.000 CPU-Kernen, mehr als 32 TB RAM und über 5 PB Storage. Diese solide Architektur haben wir selbst aufgebaut und kontinuierlich verbessert. Neben einem großartigen Team, das auf einem hohen technischen Niveau arbeitet, bilden wir uns regelmäßig in verschiedenen Fachbereichen weiter und nehmen an internationalen Konferenzen wie dem OpenStack Summit oder der EuroPython teil. Dadurch können wir uns mit der Community austauschen und neue Impulse mitbringen. Wir tauschen uns regelmäßig aus und sorgen dafür, dass jeder Mitarbeiter und jede Mitarbeiterin stets Unterstützung erhält und auf einem aktuellen Wissensstand ist.

At Wisevu™ and our sister brands Homevu™ and CharityMarketing.com, we’ve been driving digital marketing success for over 17 years, specializing in SEO, digital PR, AI, content marketing, and web development for healthcare, home services, and charity clients in Canada, USA, and Europe.

Learn more at wisevu.com.

We’re looking for a talented SEO Specialist to join our remote team. This role is also commonly referred to as a SEO Analyst, Organic Search Specialist, Organic Search Specialist or Digital Marketing Specialist, depending on your background and industry experience.

As an SEO Specialist at Wisevu, you will be working with a lead SEO Accounts Manager to help execute and implement diverse SEO tasks and improve clients’ search engine rankings both on-page and off-page. You will also be working with a team of content writers, web designers, developers, PPC experts, and SEOs to help create highly effective web pages that are crafted for optimal search engine rankings, user experience and conversions.

  • Ensure timely publication of recurring content aligned with Wisevu’s quality standards.

  • Maintain Google My Business profiles, including image uploads and posts.
  • Set up and manage Google Tag Manager, Analytics, Data Studio, call tracking, rank tracking, and other conversion tools; perform analytics audits to identify and fix tracking issues.

  • Minimum of 3 years of SEO experience working within a digital marketing agency.
  • Excellent command of the English language.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, IT, or a relevant field.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Google Analytics Certifications.

Benefits

  • Premium training programs and access to an internal knowledge base built across 17 years of hands-on experience.
  • Professional equipment budget.
  • Access to cutting-edge tools (SEO platforms, Analytics tools, and more).

We’re excited to see your work and hear your ideas, and work on exciting projects together.

We kindly ask that you provide us with your resume in English.

Medical Assistant – (Part-Time)

Schedule: Monday–Friday | 2:00 PM – 7:00 PM CST

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Part-Time

Compensation: $16–$18 per hour (based on experience)

Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and patient-focused Medical Assistant to support a telehealth and care management program in a structured, high-volume outreach environment.

This role blends traditional Medical Assistant responsibilities with phone-based patient engagement. The majority of the shift will involve outbound patient outreach, appointment scheduling, and documentation; however, candidates must also be comfortable performing core clinical support duties in a remote setting.

This is not an in-clinic position. The work is conducted remotely and requires strong communication skills, efficiency, and comfort working within defined performance metrics.

Core Responsibilities

Patient Outreach & Scheduling

  • Conduct high-volume outbound and inbound patient calls during scheduled shift
  • Schedule Annual Wellness Visits and care management appointments
  • Provide professional patient education regarding preventive services
  • Meet daily outreach and scheduling performance targets

Medical Assistant Support Duties

  • Perform medication reconciliation with patients
  • Update medical histories, allergies, and preventive care gaps
  • Collect and document patient-reported vitals when applicable
  • Prepare charts for provider review
  • Ensure accurate documentation within the EHR
  • Support care coordination and follow-up activities

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain HIPAA compliance at all times
  • Accurately document all patient interactions in the EHR
  • Escalate clinical concerns to supervising providers as appropriate

What This Role Requires

  • Comfort making 50–80 patient calls per shift
  • Strong phone presence and ability to engage Medicare-aged patients
  • Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, structured environment
  • Excellent multitasking and documentation skills
  • Professionalism and resilience when handling objections or voicemail-heavy outreach

Qualifications

  • Medical Assistant certification or equivalent healthcare experience required
  • Prior experience in a medical office, primary care, or care coordination setting
  • Prior call center experience strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with Epic, NextGen, or similar EHR systems preferred
  • Experience working with Medicare populations preferred

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Self-motivated and disciplined in a remote setting
  • Comfortable with performance metrics and call volume expectations
  • Detail-oriented and clinically accurate
  • Reliable and punctual for scheduled shift
  • Able to balance patient empathy with efficiency
Salary: $16–$18 per hour
